_notes.source: Official Lucid Trading help centre (support.lucidtrading.com), fetched 2026-10-03: articles 12945790 (LucidFlex evaluation, updated 31 Aug 2026), 12945796 (LucidFlex payouts), 12945815 (LucidFlex drawdown), 16226050 (LucidFlex customization), 12890029 (LucidPro evaluation, updated 26 Aug 2026), 12890092 (LucidPro payouts), 12890136 (LucidPro drawdown), 16226068 (LucidPro customization), 15996664 (LucidDaily evaluation), 15997266 (LucidDaily payouts), 15998425 (LucidDaily drawdown), 16085900 (LucidDaily daily loss limit), 16033858 (LucidDaily customization), 12890148 (LucidDirect funded account), 12890164 (LucidDirect payouts), 12890192 (LucidDirect drawdown), 11404620 (fees), 11404614 (platforms), 11404636 (restricted countries, updated 26 Aug 2026), 13891785 / 14315460 / 14316866 (LucidMaxx). lucidtrading.com itself blocks automated access (Cloudflare), so company and affiliate details were read from Internet Archive copies of the official pages: https://lucidtrading.com/about-us/ and /affiliate/ (captured 10 Jun 2026), /terms-of-use/ (captured 10 Jun 2026).
_notes.pricing: PRICES NOT RECORDED. The live pricing page could not be read (Cloudflare block), and the help centre does not list prices for Flex, Pro, Daily or Direct. The newest archived copy of the pricing page (5 Aug 2026) is older than the checkout options added on 6 Aug 2026 (daily loss limit on/off, and EOD or intraday drawdown on LucidDaily), each of which changes the price, so it was not used. Every price is null until we have screenshots of the live pricing page. All four plans are one-time fees with no activation fee (help centre).
_notes.billing: One-time fee, no subscription and no automatic rebilling; resets must be bought. No activation fee to move from evaluation to funded.
_notes.rules_detail: All sizes allow 2 / 4 / 6 / 10 minis (or 10x micros). LucidFlex: profit target $1,250 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000, EOD trailing max loss $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500, 50% consistency in the evaluation, optional daily loss limit at checkout (amounts not stated, so daily_loss = null). Funded payouts need 5 days each with at least $100 / $150 / $200 / $250 profit; up to 5 payouts, then moved live. LucidPro: same targets and max loss, daily loss limit as listed (none on 25K) unless turned off at checkout for a higher price; can pass in one trading day; 40% consistency applies to funded payouts only. LucidDaily: same targets and max loss, 50% consistency in the evaluation, daily loss limit $600 / $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700 on both phases unless turned off at checkout; evaluation drawdown is EOD or intraday (your choice), funded is always intraday; no per-payout cap but a maximum daily profit of $6,000 / $8,000 / $10,000 / $12,000 moves you live. LucidDirect: no evaluation; EOD trailing max loss $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $5,000; fixed daily loss limit none / $1,200 / $2,100 / $3,000 plus a scaling limit of 60% of peak EOD balance; 20% consistency on payouts; payout profit goal $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 for payout 1, then $1,250 / $2,500 / $3,500 / $4,500. Drawdown on all plans locks at starting balance + $100.
_notes.payout_caps: LucidFlex: 50% of profit up to $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 on every request (recorded as payout_cap). LucidPro: payout 1 up to $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000, payouts 2+ up to $1,500 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $3,500. LucidDirect: payouts 1-3 up to $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000, payouts 4-5 up to $1,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $3,500. LucidDaily: no per-request cap. Minimum request $500 on all plans.
_notes.profit_split: 90/10 on every funded plan from the first payout (help centre). Accounts bought before 28 Nov 2025 had 100% on the first $10K; not relevant to new buyers.
_notes.fee_refund: Not stated on any page we could read, so null.
_notes.min_trading_days: LucidPro: 'Pass the evaluation in one trading day' = 1. LucidFlex and LucidDaily: no minimum is stated, although the 50% consistency rule means at least two days in practice; left null. LucidDirect: none stated; left null.
_notes.not_listed: LucidMaxx (invite-only, live from the start, eval price $110-$680 depending on how many live accounts the trader has blown) and LucidBlack (legacy, no longer sold) are not listed.
_notes.company: Terms of use: website operated by Lucid Trading Group LLC. About page footer (June 2026): 3500 S Dupont Hwy, Dover DE 19901 (this is a common registered-agent address, so it may not be a real office). Copyright line reads '2024-2026', but no official page states a founding date, so founded = null. Not related to any firm already listed.
_notes.affiliate_program: Exists but CLOSED to applications. The affiliate page (archived 10 Jun 2026) says: 'Applications are closed... Our team scouts partners directly' based on trading credibility, community, brand alignment and consistency; there is no application form. No commission %, cookie length or payout method is published. A comparison site would have to be approached by Lucid. Could not confirm whether this is still the case on the live site (blocked).
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official Lucid page we could read. Prices especially need screenshots.

firm.name: Lucid Trading
firm.about: Lucid Trading is a US futures-only prop firm offering one-time-fee evaluations (LucidFlex, LucidPro and LucidDaily) and a straight-to-funded LucidDirect account, in sizes from $25K to $150K, with a 90% profit split on funded accounts.

countries.notes: Applies to citizens as well as residents. The regions of Crimea, Sevastopol, Donetsk, Luhansk and Kherson are also listed (no separate codes). Kosovo is recorded as XK (a widely used code, not an official ISO one). The help centre lists 'Papua' and 'New Guinea' on separate lines; recorded as Papua New Guinea. The United Arab Emirates and the United States are not on the list.
